title: Cosmic Heart Ritual
description: A pale hand wearing a glowing ring rests on the right edge of a large, ornate cosmic table filled with intricate astrological and alchemical symbols. Above the table floats a large crystalline heart structure containing a glowing galaxy, emitting purple smoke and surrounded by butterflies under a starry sky with aurora borealis and ancient stone arches.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a pale hand with a glowing ring touching the edge of a large black cosmic altar table covered in intricate glowing astrological symbols, alchemical circles, and runes. A large crystalline heart structure floats above the table containing a starry galaxy inside, with purple mystical smoke rising from the center. Several white butterflies flutter around the left side of the table. Background shows ancient stone arches with spiral carvings, a starry night sky, and vibrant aurora borealis in teal, purple and orange hues.
